quotes.text: If you change the collection method for a subscription, only subsequently created subscription invoices use the new collection method.
Some payment methods, such as [bank transfers](https://docs.stripe.com/invoicing/bank-transfer.md), only support `send_invoice` and can’t be charged automatically.
If the first invoice remains unpaid after 23 hours, the subscription is set to `incomplete_expired`. This status is final and irreversible, voiding the open invoice and preventing future invoices.
Because auto-advancement is disabled, Stripe doesn’t automatically close the invoices, retry them, or transition them to a different status.
Stripe might mark it as `canceled` or `unpaid` (depending on your [subscriptions settings](https://dashboard.stripe.com/settings/billing/automatic)) after Stripe exhausts all payment retry attempts.

findings: The captured document at the same canonical URL describes invoice and subscription collection_method as charge_automatically versus send_invoice; Dashboard or API can set the preference, while the invoice and subscription APIs expose the attribute (new lines 9, 20-32; old lines 8, 19-31).

The new capture preserves the prior behavior, conditions and lifecycle statements through the ending, including subscription-only future-invoice effect of method changes, free trials without a payment method, manual due dates and retries, 23-hour incomplete_expired finality, and standalone invoice auto-advancement conditions (new lines 29-109; old lines 28-108).

The current source is discoverable from wiki/index.md through wiki/stripe-index.md:653 and from wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions.md via its Stripe subscription context, but it has stronger wording than either capture. Recommend a bounded source correction, not a claim that the November capture introduced a new billing behavior.
substantive_changes: No substantive behavior change is evidenced by this same-URL old/new comparison. The only lexical shift in the failed-renewal, send_invoice overdue, and invoice auto-advancement consequences is may to might (old lines 85, 87, 95; new lines 86, 88, 96); both remain conditional, not promises. Other changes are formatting, capitalization of Hosted Invoice Page, and fetch/discovery metadata (diff lines 1-108).

conflicts: Current source line 63 says a standalone automatic-charge invoice with auto_advance=false stays open indefinitely; both raws say it remains open after an initial failed attempt and Stripe does not automatically close, retry, or transition it while auto-advancement is disabled (new line 94; old line 93). Remove the absolute duration claim.

Current source line 38 presents allow_incomplete as an unconditional immediate attempt; both raws qualify the example with collection_method=charge_automatically (new line 56; old line 55). Restore that condition.

Current source line 69 labels send_invoice preferred for enterprise clients and implies audit trails; both raws describe advantages and a commonly preferred wire-transfer method for this type of client, without a universal recommendation or explicit audit-trail guarantee (new lines 100-102; old lines 99-101). Narrow the summary.

Current source line 27 says Stripe charges the payment method after a free trial, while both raws specify the customer's default payment method and explain that missing payment method can instead trigger configured pause or cancel behavior (new line 36; old line 35). Preserve that qualification.
unresolved_questions: The two static captures do not establish current account-specific payment-method eligibility, actual Dashboard settings, or that any invoice was sent, charged, collected, finalized, or paid.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/billing/collection-method, the 2026-11-07 capture documents charge_automatically and send_invoice for invoices and subscriptions, with Dashboard or API configuration and a changed subscription method affecting only later invoices (new lines 9, 20-32). A failed initial automatic subscription attempt under allow_incomplete can produce incomplete; an unpaid first invoice after 23 hours reaches final incomplete_expired (new lines 56-60). The matched 2026-05-13 capture says the same (old lines 8, 19-31, 55-59). The current [[source-stripe-billing-collection-method]] covers these topics but overstates some conditions at source lines 27, 38, 63 and 69.
